description: This file contains tests for the ModalSignature React component, verifying its rendering, focus behavior, validation, and callback invocations.

methods.name: test('renders nothing when open=false')
methods.description: Verifies that the component renders nothing when the open prop is false.

methods.name: test('renders and focuses signature input when opened')
methods.description: Checks that the signature input is focused when the modal opens.

methods.name: test('validation error on empty submit shows alert')
methods.description: Ensures that submitting the form without input shows an alert.

methods.name: test('successful confirm passes signature and reason to handler')
